resources.string: Hold the document against the back of the phone and don’t move it away
The document’s chip is making you wait, often after failed attempts. Keep it still: this can take up to a minute.
The CAN or MRZ data is incorrect. Check the number you entered and the dates, then try again. Each failed attempt can lengthen the delay the chip imposes before responding.
The document was moved away too soon. Keep it still against the phone until reading is complete.
This document doesn’t comply with ICAO 9303, so its chip can’t be read.
Timed out: the chip didn’t respond in time. Try again, keeping the document still.
This document can’t be read with a CAN. Use the Passport tab and enter the MRZ data.
This document’s chip is reserved for authorized officials: Sceau can’t read it, and trying again won’t change that. This is the case for German identity cards issued before August 2021.
